# Blythe & Una Meredith

- [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) — Friend of — [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) — sworn friends and allies · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#merediths) children gather in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) graveyard and chat about their lives and local gossip. Drawn by a appetizing smell, they head down into [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and meet the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children, who share their cooked trout. The two families quickly bond and become fast friends while exchanging stories about their lives.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)_

> The children discuss the [West](../character/west.md) sisters and [Persis Ford](../character/persis-ford.md) while chatting in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). As evening falls, the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) head home to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) while [Jem](../character/jem.md) stops to pick mayflowers for his mother.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P58](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0058), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P62](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0062)_

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#merediths) children discover [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), a hungry runaway orphan, hiding in a nearby barn loft. After feeding her at the manse, they listen to her tragic backstory and teach her about religious concepts in the graveyard. [Faith](../character/faith.md) lends her clean clothes, and the children take her to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) before finding her a place to sleep in their garret.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087)_

> After [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) cautions Mr. Meredith about [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), Mr. Meredith speaks kindly to Mary and alleviates her fears. Encouraged by [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) boldly visits [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to ask if she will adopt Mary. [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) agrees after consulting Marshall, and Mary prepares to move to her new home while sharing her frank thoughts on life and stepmothers with [Una](../character/una-meredith.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P42](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0042), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080)_

> While Mr. Meredith and Jerry are away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden, [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) try to manage the house, attend a empty [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school), and clean the manse the following day. Faith's rug-shaking in the graveyard on Monday leads to local rumors and scandal among churchgoers. Meanwhile, [Carl](../character/carl.md) falls sick, but [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) recovers and the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) return home shortly after.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE

THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P48](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0048)_

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) meets [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), Di, [Faith](../character/faith.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), boasting about her new clothes and squirrel-fur muff. [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) secretly feels envious and shabby until Mary offers her the muff to try, though [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) stiffly declines. When Mary casually mentions that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) killed a rooster for dinner, [Faith](../character/faith.md) panics realizing it must be her beloved rooster [Adam](../character/adam.md) and rushes off in a rage.
